verification.notes: Aguilar was removed and arrested on September 3, 2025 after interrupting a Senate Foreign Relations Committee hearing. Video-based reports document that he and Josephine Guilbeau accused Congress of complicity in Gaza and protested U.S. support for Israel; the reviewed recording/reporting does not show him specifically naming AIPAC, so that motive is his later characterization rather than a fully confirmed description of the interruption.
